rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a Catholic priest or parish clergyperson.

example.english: This priest leads Mass in our parish every Sunday.
example.traditional: 呢位神父每個星期日都喺我哋堂區主持彌撒。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 san4 fu6 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 hai2 ngo5 dei6 tong4 keoi1 zyu2 ci4 mei4 saat3

rows.note: Use this for a priest who performs sacrifices or religious rites, especially in biblical, ancient, or temple contexts.

example.english: The ancient Israelite priest would offer sacrifices at the temple.
example.traditional: 古代以色列嘅祭司會喺聖殿獻祭。
example.jyutping: gu2 doi6 ji5 sik1 lit6 ge3 zai3 si1 wui5 hai2 sing3 din6 hin3 zai3
